title: JWT token validation fails with 'token expired' even though token is freshly issued
description: The mobile application is calling APIs through API Connect and intermittently getting 401 token expired errors even though the token was issued just seconds ago. It does not happen every time - maybe 10-15% of calls. The app is generating a new token for each session.

worklogs.description: Checked token issue timestamps vs gateway validation timestamps. Found 1-3 minute discrepancies.
Checked DataPower gateway NTP sync. NTP is configured but the server clock is drifted by 4 minutes from the token issuer.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I have been looking at the token validation failures. I can see that the DataPower gateway clock is drifted by approximately 4 minutes behind the authorization server that issues the tokens. JWT validation compares the token's issued-at time against the current server clock - a 4-minute drift exceeds the clock skew tolerance on your JWT policy (which is set to 2 minutes). So a freshly issued token is seen as expired by a clock 4 minutes slow. I need to fix the gateway NTP...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I will check with the infrastructure team about the NTP server status. We did have a network maintenance window last week. Will get back to you within the hour.
